name: readers
description: The loop's reader component: one cold read on any roster row (a fresh Claude subagent, GPT via codex exec, Gemini via the antigravity MCP, DeepSeek or Qwen via OpenRouter), read-only, against a caller's mandate and documents, output captured verbatim.
